answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 24453 Country: India Title: What about the women jamat is allowed?if all followers are women?pls reply! Question: what about the women jamat is allowed?if all followers are women?pls reply! Answer ID: 24453 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1493/1165/B=1431) The jama’ah of women is makrooh tahrimi. They will not get any reward. If they offer salah in their homes individually, it is better and more righteous. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
